title: Atrahasis, and new Science and Creatures topics
summary: The library opens a new shelf: writings of other peoples and religions, translated from their own languages and read from a Christian standpoint. It begins with Atrahasis, the Babylonian story of the making of humankind and the Flood, set beside Genesis. Two new kinds of topic pages, Science and Creatures, trace the natural world and its animals, real and strange, across the whole Bible.

items.text: Updated the study notes in Genesis 7.
Added Atrahasis: a Plain English translation of all 12 chapters, with 438 study notes and 110 manuscript differences explained.
13 new topic pages, among them Faith and Science, The Firmament and the Shape of the World, Stars and Constellations, The Wild Ox and the Unicorn, Jonah's Great Fish and Famine.
A new group in the library, "Other peoples and religions", for ancient writings outside the Bible's world of faith, each with a page on reading it as a Christian.
Two new kinds of topic, Science and Creatures, on the topics page. The two pages on the cherubim are now one, Cherubim, Seraphim and the Living Creatures.
